reference.code: const nums=s=>{if(!s)return null;let o=[];for(const z of s.split(',')){if(!/^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(z))return null;let x=Number(z);if(x< -1000||x>1000)return null;o.push(x)}return o};exports.lastOccurrenceOrder=function(s){let a=nums(s);if(!a)return null;let last=new Map;a.forEach((x,i)=>last.set(x,i));return a.filter((x,i)=>last.get(x)===i).join(',')}
